# Lemon Squeezy

Lemon Squeezy is a platform designed to simplify payments, taxes, and subscriptions for software companies, offering a powerful API and webhooks for seamless integration.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/lemon-squeezy/.

## Actions

- **Create Customer**: Create a new customer.
- **List All Affiliates**: List all affiliates.
- **List All Checkouts**: List all checkouts.
- **List All Customers**: List all customers.
- **List All Discount Redemptions**: List all discount redemptions.
- **List All Discounts**: List all discounts.
- **List All License Key Instances**: List all license key instances.
- **List All Order Items**: List all order items.
- **List All Orders**: List all orders.
- **List All Prices**: List all prices.
- **List All Products**: List all products.
- **List All Stores**: List all stores.
- **List All Subscription Invoices**: List all subscription invoices.
- **List All Subscription Items**: List all subscription items.
- **List All Subscriptions**: List all subscriptions.
- **List All Usage Records**: List all usage records.
- **List All Variants**: List all variants.
- **List All Webhooks**: List all webhooks.
